About the job
 Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark , General Catalyst , Peter Thiel , Adam D'Angelo , Larry Summers , and Jack Dorsey .
 Position: Sonic Audit Specialist - Hindi
 Type: Contract 
 Compensation: $18/hour 
 Location: Remote 
 Role Responsibilities

• Evaluate AI training data by auditing multilingual transcription and forced alignment tasks.

• Review recordings and transcriptions to ensure accuracy, applying error codes and providing rationale.

• Verify and correct word-level segmentation in audio, adjusting timestamps and transcriptions as needed.

• Collaborate asynchronously, working independently to meet deadlines and improve AI model performance .

• Maintain consistency in applying rubrics across judgments, enhancing the quality of AI-generated content .

 Qualifications

 Must-Have 

• Native or near-native command of Hindi as spoken in India. 

• Strong English reading and writing skills. 

• Experience in transcription, subtitling, localization, linguistic annotation, or QA. 

• Ability to distinguish similar sounds and identify word boundaries in continuous speech. 

 Preferred 

• Experience in AI data annotation or model evaluation. 

• Background in phonetics or linguistics. 

• Familiarity with audio editing or waveform tools. 

 Application Process (Takes 20–30 mins to complete) 

• Upload resume 

• AI interview based on your resume 

• Submit form
